title: CURCUMA LONGA (TURMERIC) ROOT EXTRACT - Ataman Kimya
abstract:
The rhizomes of this plant are dug up and used for medicinal and food purposes.  
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract is yellow-orange in color from the inside, which makes it called the golden spice.
Curcumin is the main active ingredient that gives Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract its color.
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, obtained from dried rhizomes, has been used internally and externally since ancient times to beautify the skin.  
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract is widely used in cooking and gives Indian curry its flavor and yellow color.
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract is also used in mustard and to color butter and cheese.
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract has been used in both Ayurvedic and Chinese medicine as an anti-inflammatory, to treat digestive and liver problems, skin diseases, and wounds.  
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract has been used for 4,000 years to treat a variety of conditions.
Studies show that Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract may help fight infections and some cancers, reduce inflammation, and treat digestive problems.
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract may not work as well in humans.  
Some studies have used an injectable form of curcumin, the active substance in Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, and not all studies agree.
Finally, some of the studies show conflicting evidence.  
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract can be used as a spot treatment to naturally reduce the appearance of blemishes.
Friedrich Ratzel reported in The History of Mankind during 1896, that in Micronesia, turmeric powder was applied for embellishment of body, clothing, utensils, and ceremonial uses.
Native Hawaiians who introduced it to Hawaii (Hawaiian: ʻōlena) make a bright yellow dye out of it.  
CURCUMA LONGA (TURMERIC) ROOT EXTRACT AT A GLANCE:
\*Curcuma longa root is the source of the spice \*Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract
\*Contains curcumin, a lipophilic, polyphenolic antioxidant pigment
\*Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract plays a compelling role in promoting healthier, normalized skin
\*Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract can help calm skin  
BENEFITS OF CURCUMA LONGA (TURMERIC) ROOT EXTRACT:
\*Soothing,
\*Anti-Aging  
CURCUMA LONGA (TURMERIC) ROOT EXTRACT PARTS USED:
The roots, or rhizomes and bulbs, are used in medicine and food.
They are generally boiled and then dried, turning into the familiar yellow powder.
Curcumin, the active ingredient, has antioxidant properties.
Other substances in this herb have antioxidant properties as well.  
AVAILABLE FORMS OF CURCUMA LONGA (TURMERIC) ROOT EXTRACT:
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract is available in the following forms:
Capsules containing powder
Fluid extract
Tincture
Bromelain increases the absorption and anti-inflammatory effects of curcumin, so it is often combined with Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract products.  
HOW TO TAKE CURCUMA LONGA (TURMERIC) ROOT EXTRACT:
Pediatric
The golden yellow color of Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract is due to curcumin.  
Phytochemical components of Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract include diarylheptanoids, a class including numerous curcuminoids, such as curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin.  
Curcumin constitutes up to 3.14% of assayed commercial samples of Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract (the average was 1.51%); curry powder contains much less (an average of 0.29%).
Some 34 essential oils are present in Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, among which turmerone, germacrone, atlantone, and zingiberene are major constituents  
CATEGORIES OF CURCUMA LONGA (TURMERIC) ROOT EXTRACT:
\*Antioxidant,
\*Plant Extracts  
MEDICAL RESEARCH OF CURCUMA LONGA (TURMERIC) ROOT EXTRACT:
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract and curcumin have been studied in numerous clinical trials for various human diseases and conditions, with no high-quality evidence of any anti-disease effect or health benefit.
There is no scientific evidence that curcumin reduces inflammation, as of 2020.  
There is weak evidence that Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract may be beneficial for relieving symptoms of knee osteoarthritis, as well as for reducing pain and muscle damage following physical exercise.
There is good evidence that Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract is an allergen  
Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract is the source of the spice turmeric.
